classification.habitat: Dry tropical and subtropical regions; cultivated widely
classification.distribution: Widely cultivated and naturalized across India and other tropical regions

identification.description: Fast-growing tree with compound leaves, fragrant flowers and long three-sided pods.
identification.whole_plant: Small to medium tree with open crown.
identification.root: Strong root system; roots may have characteristic pungency.
identification.stem: Soft to moderately woody trunk with pale bark and branching crown.
identification.leaf: Tripinnate compound leaves with many small rounded leaflets.
identification.flower: Fragrant white to cream flowers in branched inflorescences.
identification.fruit: Long, pendulous, three-angled cylindrical pods containing many seeds.
identification.seed: Rounded seeds with three papery wings.
identification.bark: Greyish to whitish bark, becoming rough with age.

therapeutics.precautions: Different plant parts have different traditional uses; avoid unsupervised concentrated root preparations.

reference_hubs: TDU Indian Medicinal Plants Database — Shlokas

phytochemistry.chemical_notes: Composition differs substantially by plant part and processing.

modern_information.evidence_summary: Moringa oleifera is nutritionally important and widely studied for phytochemical properties; claims of therapeutic benefit should be tied to specific preparations and evidence.
modern_information.safety_notes: Part-specific safety matters, particularly for concentrated root/bark material.

exam_points: Compound leaves and long pods are key characters
viva_questions: What is the botanical name of Shigru?
mnemonics: SHIGRU = small leaflets + long drumstick pods
student.quick_revision: Shigru — Moringa oleifera — Moringaceae — tripinnate leaves — long pods.

teaching_points: Demonstrate leaf, flower and pod characters
practical_points: Observe leaf architecture and pod cross-section

doctor.quick_reference: Traditional drug with part-specific uses; concentrated root/bark preparations require caution.
